- Supporting and expected additional data: Dihydrorhodamine (DHR) flow cytometry would be expected to show markedly reduced or absent oxidative burst. Genetic testing would most likely reveal a mutation in CYBB (gp91phox) if X‑linked CGD.
- Conclusion: The constellation of early-onset recurrent infections and an abnormal NBT with decreased neutrophil oxidative burst points to Chronic Granulomatous Disease (most likely X‑linked).

[DIAGNOSIS]
Chronic granulomatous disease (NADPH oxidase deficiency), most likely X‑linked CGD.
